label: baseline
description: Gate baseline: work-package / skip-optional / robot + hot-resource probe, context_mode fresh. Recorded 2026-08-20 against workflows@46bddccc. Delivery is 30,199 characters above the workflows@72db28ae recording of 1,302,319, and every character of the rise is resource delivery (+31,343); technique delivery falls 2,329 as a retired input and two trimmed protocol steps come out. Resource text is refetched on each activity, so a sentence added to a hot template is paid once per activity — which is what makes this rise large against 11,000 characters of net new resource text. What it buys: one canonical five-field finding shape with declared extension points, replacing three report guides that each declared their own field list and drifted; a declared designator prefix and review category for the structural analysis and the lean-coding audit, whose absence is why a run improvised identifiers and rendered sixteen findings as two rows on a live pull request; the rule that a designator belongs to the pass that raised the finding; and a findings table that opens on its subject rather than a count that goes stale. 2,155 of the characters are meta/writing-register, delivered for the first time because the resource-reference extractor now keeps the workflow a cross-workflow citation points at — the register was cited and silently never delivered before. Findings and evidence: https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/issues/474.
